english.meaning: to break up into pieces; to come apart
english.note: 散晒 means everything has fallen apart or scattered. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Or curry chicken, cooked until the meat’s so tender the bones fall apart.
exampleSentences.traditional: 或者係咖喱雞。揦到啲肉呢，嗰啲骨都散埋嗰啲呢。
